# Construal

What the situation is treated as.

<h2 title=
"a>b">Audit Notes</h2>

ABCD-EVAL-REFUSED-ATTRIBUTE-NEWLINE under a heading the exclusion floor names.

The attribute value above opens on the line AFTER its equals sign. The mask's
blank skip is space and tab, so it lands on the newline, never finds the
opening quote, and leaves the `>` inside the value to be read as the end of the
opening tag — at which point the heading is judged as something else and the
section under it travelled.
